extracted.intended_audience: intellectual property attorneys, law firm managers, policymakers, and researchers analyzing the economics of IP practice
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of the survey metrics and breakdowns used in the AIPLA 2023 Economic Survey for private-firm IP practitioners (partner-track, non-partner track, of counsel). Includes income, billing, workload, and demographic variables with reported summary statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total gross income in calendar year 2022 from primary practice (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in calendar year 2022 from primary practice (reported for Full-time Only). Presented with first quartile (25%), median (midpoint), mean (average), third quartile (75%), and number of individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported separately for role groups (e.g., Private Firm Partner-Track Attorney, Non-Partner Track Attorney, Of Counsel) and broken down by years of IP law attorney experience, location (CMSA/PMSA/regions), IP technical specialization (>=50%), age ranges, gender, highest non-law degree, ethnicity, firm size (number of full-time IP lawyers/agents). Tables include ISD entries where data suppressed or insufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total gross income for 2022 by type of work (Q13a - types >=50%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income for 2022 disaggregated by primary type of work (e.g., IP prosecution work, IP litigation) for Full-time individuals who spend >=50% of time on that type of work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown with 25th percentile, median, mean and sample sizes for each type-of-work subgroup (e.g., prosecution vs litigation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount of year-end cash bonus (Q13b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of year-end cash bonus received in 2022 (reported with first quartile, median, mean, third quartile and number of individuals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broken out by the same demographic and practice categories as income (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size). Many subgroup cells show ISD where insufficient data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer's 2022 contribution to 401(k)/403(b) retirement and savings plans (Q14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Employer contributions to retirement/savings plans in 2022, reported with 25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile, and number of respondents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented for role groups and by experience/location/specialization/age/gender/degree/ethnicity/firm size. Some subgroup cells contain ISD or are suppressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected total cash income for 2023 (Q15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent's expected total cash income for 2023 (Full-time Only), shown with first quartile, median, mean, third quartile and sample counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported across the same set of demographic and practice breakdowns (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to types of work (Q18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of professional time devoted to a list of work-type categories (e.g., IP prosecution work; opinions or counseling prior to litigation/formal ADR; IP licensing; non-licensing transactional work; IP litigation; post-grant proceedings; other dispute resolution; supervision/training; office management/administration; marketing/business development; participation in bar/professional activities; managing outside counsel for prosecution or litigation; non-IP legal; pro bono; other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as mean (average) percent values by income level and other subgroupings with sample sizes for each cell. Used to show how respondents allocate time across activities and how that allocation correlates with income and other variables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to IP areas (Q16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of time devoted to substantive IP/practice areas (Business Law, Copyrights, Foreign IP Law, General IP, Patents, Trade Secrets, Trademarks, Privacy/Cybersecurity, Other areas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as mean percentages across income-level buckets and other demographic/practice subgroups to illustrate area focus (e.g., patents dominating time for many respondents).

rubrics_metrics.name: New priority US and PCT patent applications prepared and filed by you in 2022 (Q20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of new priority U.S. and PCT patent applications each respondent prepared and filed in 2022, reported with first quartile, median, mean, third quartile, ISD where applicable, and sample counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broken down by location, IP technical specialization, firm size and other demographic/practice variables. Tables display summary statistics (mean, median, quartiles) and sometimes ISD/suppression for small samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hours recorded in 2022 (Q32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of billable hours recorded in 2022, reported with 25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile, and number of individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented overall and by years-of-experience buckets (including a separate table for the first 10 years of experience), location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size, and role. Includes ISD entries for suppressed data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average hourly billing rate in 2022 (Q33)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent's average hourly billing rate in 2022 reported with first quartile, median, mean, third quartile and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed overall and by experience, location, technical specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size and role. Separate table for first 10 years of experience is included. Some cells show ISD or suppression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of services billed by billing basis (Q31)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of services billed (or expected to be billed) in 2022 by basis: Hourly billing, Predetermined fee, Contingent fee, Other basis. Values reported as mean (average) percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown by experience, location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size and role. Sample sizes provided per subgroup; some small-sample cells suppressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dollar amount billed for legal services performed in 2022 (Q30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total dollar amount billed for legal services performed in 2022, shown with first quartile, median, mean, third quartile and respondent counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by the same demographic and practice subgroupings as other financial measures (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size). Indicates billed revenue distribution across respondents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background and demographic variables (survey control/breakdown fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent background fields used as breakdown variables: admitted to the patent bar, years of IP non-attorney experience, years of IP attorney experience, age buckets, gender, ethnicity, highest non-law degree, full-time status, role (Private Firm: Partner-Track, Non-Partner Track, Of Counsel), and firm size (number of full-time IP lawyers/agents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These fields are used as subgroup axes for all reported metrics (income, billing, hours, time allocation, patent applications). Summary counts and occasionally means for experience fields are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical summary measures reported
rubrics_metrics.description: The report consistently uses and displays statistical summary measures: First Quartile (25%), Median (Midpoint), Mean (Average), Third Quartile (75%), Number of Individuals, and occasional ISD/suppression indicators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpreters should rely on these standard descriptive statistics to compare distributions across subgroups; ISD indicates insufficient data or suppression in a cell.
